description.en-US: Matterleast is an unofficial Android client for Mattermost servers that tries to have a feel closer to Discord. Features - Discord-style feel and navigation: you can swipe between chats, swipe on messages to react/reply etc. - One Home inbox across all servers for unread messages, mentions, threads and saved messages - Notifications without Google's push service via a background job - Tablet layout in landscape - Different theming options: Matterleast colours, your Mattermost theme or Material You Other (obvious) features that exist: threads, reactions, file previews, sharing, search, custom emojis, bots, channel management and more. Limitations - Calls, Playbooks and Boards are not supported, nor are Apps framework forms and message translation. - Notifications don't go through Mattermost's push proxy, so new messages arrive when the app checks (about every 15 minutes) unless "Stay connected" is on. To use this app, you need the address of a Mattermost server and an account on it. The app talks to that server and, depending on its settings and the messages you open, to other hosts such as link previews, images and the server's plugins. Since these services aren't necessarily free software, it's labeled with "NonFreeNet". This app is significantly vibe-coded / created using LLMs. Most of its code has not been thoroughly reviewed by a human. Matterleast is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mattermost, Inc.
